goal: Adopt and independently reproduce the Core v0.2 shadow seed while building a read-only full-spectrum memory index adapter/manifest contract. Preserve zero downtime and current live core authority.
required_behaviors: Fresh-read and reproduce architect seed exact bytes/tests; architect 10/10 is not trusted as PASS.

Preserve multidimensional memory weights, versioned append-only/deduplicated affective store, bounded associative recall, self-gap times self-relevant meaning motivation candidate, and reflection behavioral-principle proposals.
Generated goals remain candidates only and cannot execute or mutate live Identity, Personality, Governance, Approved Memory, or durable mission state.
Full-spectrum memory means all indexed classes are routable but content is loaded lazily: bootstrap L0 00->31->32->33 then task-routed L1-L4 only.
Reject eager full-corpus load and reject copying a second complete memory bank.
Build deterministic content-addressed memory source manifest/index adapter using source pointers and metadata, not raw corpus duplication.

Memory candidate metadata must include source_type/source_ref/fingerprint/confidence/verified_count/last_verified/ttl/contradictions/depends_on/affects/personality_impact/disposition or deterministic equivalent.
Raw chat, single-window self-report, ambiguous provenance, secret-like content, protected/core-impact candidates cannot directly promote; route to Working/Memory Inbox/Quarantine.
Track-B failure cannot reset or mutate Track-A primary live mission state; cross-track merge uses compact state/evidence/provenance pointers only.
Formal workers remain exactly A/B/C; no slot4 and no new platform task.
acceptance: Builder compile/tests are reproducible and result label is BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED only.
Memory adapter/manifest is deterministic for identical indexed inputs and changes hash when source metadata changes.
No Google Drive core memory documents are modified in this Builder step; memory access is read-only/indexed.
No model download, training, package installation, monetary spend, secret persistence, main/default write, production deployment, or live Identity/Personality/Governance mutation.
Builder emits exactly one compact Evidence file and exactly one B-to-C packet, then state becomes READY_FOR_VERIFY/current_role=LCR-C.
return_condition: After independent C PASS of dual-core shadow/memory Phase1, return to A and resume the original zero-cost lightweight expert candidate benchmark path unless a new explicit owner authorization changes priority.
